pieces.placement: Black ribbed high-neck fitted sweater worn on the torso with the turtleneck covering the base of the neck and long sleeves extending to the wrists.
pieces.visibleEdges: Neckline and full upper body of the sweater are visible above the skirt waistband; sleeve cuffs are visible at both wrists; lower body hem is mostly hidden because it is tucked into the skirt.
pieces.tucking: Sweater is tucked into the high waist of the skirt, creating a smooth fitted waistline.
pieces.accessoryPosition: Shoulder bag strap runs over the wearer's right shoulder and lies on top of the sweater; necklace chain rests over the sweater at the neck and upper chest.

pieces.placement: Metallic silver pleated high-waist maxi skirt worn from the natural waist down to the ankles, flaring softly toward the hem.
pieces.visibleEdges: Waistband is clearly visible at the midsection beneath the tucked sweater; full pleated length is visible; lower hem falls to ankle level and parts slightly in front to reveal the boots beneath.
pieces.tucking: Receives the sweater tucked inside the waistband.

pieces.placement: Black leather ankle boots worn on both feet under the maxi skirt, with the shafts reaching the ankles and block heels visible below the skirt hem.
pieces.visibleEdges: Only the lower front portions, toes, and heels are visible beneath the skirt's hem opening.
pieces.closure: not visible in the outfit image; product is an ankle boot with side closure construction, but closure is covered by the skirt and angle.

pieces.placement: Small black shoulder bag worn at the wearer's right side, hanging high under the right arm from a short shoulder strap.
pieces.visibleEdges: Bag body is visible at the right rib/waist area; strap is visible from the top of the right shoulder down to the bag; the bag sits partly in front of the right sleeve side seam area.
pieces.closure: Top flap bag; flap closure hardware details are not fully readable in the outfit image, but the bag appears closed.
pieces.accessoryPosition: Strap rests on the right shoulder over the sweater, with the bag tucked close against the right underarm and side torso.

pieces.placement: Fine silver chain necklace worn around the neck with a small pendant centered on the upper chest over the sweater.
pieces.visibleEdges: Chain is visible around the front of the turtleneck area and the small pendant hangs visibly at center front just below the neck.
pieces.accessoryPosition: Necklace lies against the front of the black sweater, pendant centered above the bust line.

plan.instructions: Arrange the outfit with the black ribbed high-neck sweater as the base upper-body garment, fully tucked into the metallic silver pleated maxi skirt at the natural waist. Let the skirt sit over the sweater and fall to ankle length, leaving a slight front opening at the hem so the black ankle boots remain partially visible underneath. Place the fine silver pendant necklace over the sweater, centered at the upper chest. Wear the small black shoulder bag on the right shoulder with the strap over the sweater and the bag resting snugly under the right arm. No outerwear, hosiery, headwear, or additional jewelry are present.
